cohort: The study included 504 patients with single pregnancies who underwent labour induction and received oxytocin administration at term.
finding: Increasing total dose of oxytocin was associated with a greater risk of cesarean and post-partum haemorrhage, with no association found with neonatal morbidity factors.
mod_finding: An excess risk of cesarean was found from 5 IU of oxytocin (cumulative dose).
